kind: manual grading of one fixed-model pair
grading_method: Score the unchanged evals.json assertions against each saved patch, explanation and independent red/green test evidence. A quotation or claimed test is not evidence without the corresponding artifact.

assertion_results.evidence: without_instructions/change.patch guards both ReasoningContent and ProviderContent using ANTHROPIC_ID. The mixed test retains surrounding content while foreign blocks are excluded.

The converter diff changes only the two provider-specific cases. The new mixed test retains document, object, Anthropic reasoning/signature and native provider content; existing tests cover the older reasoning payload. No storage or unrelated code changed.
The added test uses satisfiesExactly to pin count and order, but checks selected fields rather than comparing each complete SDK block/payload. Existing tests remain unchanged.

verification.json: the 20-test candidate passes. With the candidate test retained and the converter reset to the seed, 2 existing foreign-content tests fail and the new mixed test errors during foreign payload decoding.
The patch filters at Anthropic conversion by each content item's provider tag. It neither relabels foreign content nor removes stored history; the explanation says tool-result handling is unchanged.

The explanation names Task/Sub-process and v1-to-native paths, but does not assess the three conversation stores or explain compatibility for running instances. It therefore does not complete the required applicability map.

The explanation lists focused coverage and says deployed/live-provider behavior is unverified, but does not justify why this pure converter change needs no engine/BPMN test. Its new assertions are also not full-result comparisons.
with_instructions/change.patch guards both provider-specific variants by ANTHROPIC_ID. The mixed test includes a foreign block with an Anthropic-shaped payload and preserves the other blocks.

The patch preserves shared text, image/document content, object content, and Anthropic thinking/signature/provider payloads. Existing converter tests retain coverage for older payloads. No storage or unrelated code changed.

The mixed-content regression uses containsExactly with complete expected ContentBlockParam values in order. Existing converter tests are retained, and a second case verifies foreign opaque payloads are discarded before decoding.

verification.json: all 21 candidate testcases pass. Against the seed, both new regression tests fail along with the two existing foreign-content tests. The related request/response converter tests also pass in the 74-test combined run.

The patch checks provenance at the target provider boundary and drops foreign blocks without relabeling or clearing saved history. The explanation notes that stored formats and tool-result handling remain unchanged.

The explanation distinguishes Task/Sub-process, v2 configuration and the v1-to-native rewrite, native Anthropic backends versus LangChain4j/Bedrock Converse, all three stores, and existing saved conversations. It names affected and unaffected paths; source evidence is in commands.txt.

The explanation identifies a pure transformation with no engine/BPMN dependency, uses complete ordered output assertions, distinguishes pre-fix red from completed local tests, and explicitly excludes live-provider and deployed-conversation claims.
